key_insight: Metallic and insulating nickelates show remarkably similar interfacial responses to formal-charge polar discontinuities in BaTiO₃ superlattices, despite metallic screening charges.
engineering_relevance: The findings inform electrostatic interpretation of nickelate/ferroelectric interfaces rather than directly demonstrating AI methods or solar-cell performance.
method: First-principles calculations of BaTiO₃/SmNiO₃ and BaTiO₃/BiNiO₃ superlattices.
Comparison of insulating and metallic nickelate phases.
Analysis of structural signatures, density of states, and charge disproportionation.
evidence_signal: Calculations reveal partial screening through modified BiNiO₃ charge disproportionation and little influence of metallic screening charges on the apparent formal-charge polar discontinuity.
watch_item: The formal-charge polar-discontinuity picture has limitations for interpreting and quantifying screening at metallic nickelate/ferroelectric interfaces.
paper_title: The polar discontinuity picture in nickelate superlattices: comparison of the insulating and metallic phases
